name: Collage
source:
Three ordinary people are thrown together, and each retells events in his or her own voice in this unconventionally told, uniquely presented, and ultimately very human novella.

[From [url=http://at2006.haeleth.net/game.php?id=6]AstCd2[/url]]
translation:
三个平凡的人因缘际会地走到一起，各自以自己的声音重述发生过的事情。这部短篇小说叙事方式反常规，表现形式别具一格，最终讲述的却是一个无比真实的人性故事。

[摘自[url=http://at2006.haeleth.net/game.php?id=6]AstCd2[/url]]
